underlying_work: Photograph of a cat, plus registered marks
enforcement_history: Jury verdict January 2018 totalling $710,001: $230,000 statutory copyright, $480,000 statutory trademark, $1 contract. Infringing goods were coffee and t-shirts.
curatorial_note: The clearest merch precedent in the whole register. The defendant even had a licence and still lost by exceeding it. Cite this case in the exhibit text.
